recommendedBranch.name: Lived Rooms and Object-Use Scenes v0.12.0
recommendedBranch.whyNow: The city now knows lawful presence and real room routes, and v0.11.3 makes completed home actions readable through measured effects, useful object details, sensible context, and distinct success-only echoes. The strongest next step is authoritative active object-use scene state beneath that grammar rather than mistaking feedback or after-the-fact animation for a scene in progress.
recommendedBranch.firstExperiment: One student room, one shared bathroom, one small-house common room, and one shop or institution with real object-use spots, tiny sit/read/cook/repair/create/play/rest scenes, autonomous resident choice, and visible/compressed parity.
recommendedBranch.protectedOutcome: Rooms and persistent objects become entertaining to observe and use while privacy, autonomy, casual realism, object identity, and no routine checklist remain intact.

stages.deliverable: map existing objects to bounded actions and valid room/use positions without one best object
one current optional scene with actor, object, room, action, time, and provenance
watch or compress the same action with equal cost and outcome
residents choose grounded activities from needs, personality, interests, schedules, and owned/shared objects
private scenes remain undisclosed remotely and object use respects room/access/ownership authority
meaningful use may add bounded history without turning normal use into durability chores
bind the existing low-graphic motion grammar to authoritative scene state only after affordance, permission, duration, privacy, and visible/compressed parity exist

deferred: object-use battle passes or artificial gating
mergeGates: visible mode grants no hidden reward
presence and object use grant no wider authority
